about: The edits (SUBSTACK-EDITS-IC1101.json, apply_ic1101.py) went into his post through its editor in the app's browser, the way the community handoff says (his Substack, signed in): each Find string occurred once, inside one run of text with no marks; the six replacements went in as one editor transaction (each old string then 0 times, each new one once); the draft saved (Substack's draft record had all six); Update, then "Update now" in Substack's dialog, with the audience and settings untouched. The title still reads "Updated: Nov 1 2026", as he set it.
